step1_analysis.circuit_type: Folded-Cascode Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) / Mixer Core
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a folded-cascode front-end stage suitable for low-voltage RF applications. The NMOS acts as an RF transconductor, while the PMOS acts as a common-gate cascode device (for an LNA) or an LO switch (for a mixer), folding the signal current to the output and allowing operation from a low supply voltage.

paper_reference.title: Low-Voltage 1.9-GHz Front-End Receiver in 0.5-m CMOS Technology

voltage_gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain at the resonant frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS Id = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 = 311uA. gm = 2*311u/0.48 = 1.3mA/V. With a 5kOhm tank load, Gain = gm * Rload = 6.5 V/V = 16.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the quality factor and parallel resistance of the LC tank used as the load.

center_frequency.description: Frequency at which the LNA achieves maximum gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the LC tank. For L=5nH and C=1.4pF, f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(LC)) = 1.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Parasitic capacitances from the transistors will slightly lower the center frequency from the ideal LC resonance.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power drawn from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_n = 311uA, Id_p = 193uA. Total current = 504uA. Power = 1.8V * 504uA = 0.9 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law models for SKY130 at VDD=1.8V with given bias voltages.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC voltage gain, center frequency, and power consumption of the folded-cascode LNA. An LC tank is added at the output to tune the amplifier to 1.9 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded-Cascode LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmg=5u L_xmg=0.5u
.param W_xms=5u L_xms=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* AC source for AC analysis, SIN for transient
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 1.9G 0 0)
VBIAS BIAS 0 DC 0.5

* RF Choke for folding node (DC short to VDD, AC open)
LZT ZT VDD 1m

* LC Tank Load tuned to ~1.9 GHz
Ltank VOUT 0 5n
Ctank VOUT 0 1.4p
Rtank VOUT 0 5k

* DUT
XMG VOUT BIAS ZT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmg} w={W_xmg}
XMS ZT VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xms} w={W_xms}

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 100MEG 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac gain_19g find gain_db at=1.9G

tran 10p 20n
meas tran v_out_max max v(VOUT) from=10n to=20n
meas tran v_out_min min v(VOUT) from=10n to=20n
let v_out_pp = v_out_max - v_out_min
let tran_gain = v_out_pp / 0.02
print tran_gain
.endc
.end
